✅ gemini 完成 `T02-runner-timeout-wrap` — Runner: Task.WhenAny(handler.ExecuteAsync, Task.Delay) wrap + args _timeout_sec override
💁 Runner 用 UniTask.WhenAny(handler.ExecuteAsync, UniTask.Delay) wrap. 讀 args._timeout_sec int 覆寫 handler.TimeoutSeconds. timeout 先到 → cts.Cancel() + throw TimeoutException → catch 走 LastRunError 標, 下一筆 cmd 照跑.
